gloss_en: Cannot export the Revit Category into a user-defined pset via the txt config, though the built-in Revit property sets export it.
title_original: INQ: How to export Revit Category as Revit user defined property set?
question_paraphrase: If I export using Export Revit property sets I see Category, but in my user defined pset txt I tried Category, Revit Category, Category Id, Category Name and nothing comes out. Family and Type work.
phrasing_notes: pastes the txt lines with inline comments 'works' / 'nothing'
answer_summary: Acknowledged by Autodesk as an open bug (REVIT-248491); only workaround reported was Dynamo.

gloss_en: In Revit 2027 IfcProject is missing from the entity selection list so a user-defined pset cannot be added to the project.
title_original: INQ: Revit 2027: How to add a user defined property set to a project?
question_paraphrase: In Revit 2027 you depend on the selection list to add a property set and IfcProject is missing; before 2027 it was possible to add a UDPset to IfcProject.
context_given: new Manage Default Property Sets dialog
phrasing_notes: short, states regression versus earlier versions

gloss_en: In the new Revit 2027 Manage Default Property dialog not all Revit parameters appear in the Revit Property column, and what is Single/Bounded/List/Table property type for?
title_original: INQ: RVT 2027 - New Manage Property Dialog
question_paraphrase: Testing the new Manage Default Property dialog: I cannot find all Revit parameters in the Revit Property column, and changing type from Label to Length shows no properties at all. What are Single, Bounded, List, Table used for? Nothing in Revit Help.
context_given: IFC Common and User-Defined Property Sets
phrasing_notes: polite greeting, several numbered questions, notes missing docs
answer_summary: Autodesk replied that the picker lists only parameters associated with matching categories/data type; explained property types.

gloss_en: Shared parameters with names equal (ignoring case) to built-in ones (Volume, Area) are replaced by built-in values in the exported pset, no matter the txt config.
title_original: PR: IFC export ignores mapping table setting for certain built-in parameters
question_paraphrase: I try to export OBJEM (Volume) and PLOCHA (Area) shared parameters but values are replaced with built-in Objem and Plocha. No matter how I configure the TXT file.
phrasing_notes: non-English parameter names, attaches zip with project and mapping

gloss_en: Psets defined for IFCElement in the txt were not exported but switching the entity to IFCRoot made them export.
title_original: PR: Psets with IFCElement are not exported, exports only as IFCRoot
question_paraphrase: Classification parameters from a custom user-defined pset were not exported when the instance was IFCElement; changing to IFCRoot worked in all versions 2022-2025.
phrasing_notes: posts a workaround as a report
answer_summary: Autodesk could not reproduce; use IfcRoot as fallback.

gloss_en: Can custom property sets be assigned only to specific predefined types, e.g. different psets for IfcCovering.CEILING and FLOORING?
title_original: INQ: Custom property set only for Predefined Type
question_paraphrase: is there a way to assign custom property sets only to specific predefined types within the txt file for user defined property sets (different sets for IfcCovering.CEILING and IfcCovering.FLOORING)
answer_summary: Only the plain IfcCovering entity form worked in testing; predefined type filtering was not honoured.

gloss_en: User-defined psets for Revit Parts (IfcBuildingElementPart) are not exported at all; same for roofs, stairs and railings per commenters.
title_original: PR: Can't export user defined property sets for Revit Parts (ifcbuildingelementpart)
question_paraphrase: Using the latest IFC exporter I wasn't able to export any Part property using Export user defined property sets. For most other categories mapping works fine.
context_given: test rvt and txt shared via file link
phrasing_notes: asks if it is a known issue
answer_summary: Open; commenters report same for Roof, Stair, Railing.

gloss_en: After upgrading to exporter 19.3.0 only type parameters but no instance parameters export in custom psets for IfcWindow.
title_original: 19.3.0 no custom properties to IfcWindows
question_paraphrase: We're trying to export an ifc with custom property sets. In 19.1.0 this worked well. With the new release we find only type parameters in windows.
context_given: German parameter names with DIN codes
phrasing_notes: German parameter names with brackets and DIN refs mixed in English text

gloss_en: Room Area value cannot be exported into a custom pset although Area objects can (client requirement).
title_original: PR: Can't export room area to custom property set
question_paraphrase: We can't export the Area parameter value of a room object to a custom property set (client requirement). No such limitation for area objects. Tested IFC2x3 CV2 and IFC4 RVArch.

gloss_en: Custom pset appears twice in Solibri and a Classification Code parameter (NL-SfB) is not written, because building elements use the type Assembly Code and distribution elements use instance Classification Code.
title_original: Ifc Custom Property set: Double Psets / Property not written to Ifc
question_paraphrase: With 20.2.1 I have 2 issues with a custom property set. The Revit parameter Classification Code isn't exported to the custom property NL-SfB code... The custom property set is shown 2x in Solibri.
phrasing_notes: numbered issues, references Dutch classification NL-SfB

gloss_en: Exporter 23.3.1: 'Not Exported' option no longer excludes assemblies, properties of parts with openings get switched and a property set is missing.
title_original: Ifc exporter 23.3.1 (Not Exported does not respond, Switching properties, missing property set!)
question_paraphrase: In older versions I used to add Not Exported in the Ifc Options to prevent exporting assemblies but it's not working anymore with 23.3.1. He also switches some properties of the parts with openings.
phrasing_notes: exclamation marks in title, lists multiple regressions

gloss_en: Wants parameter mapping for all IFC entity attributes (Name, Description, Tag) so OOTB parameters like Mark/Comments can be used instead of duplicating IFC-prefixed parameters.
title_original: Parameter mapping for all Ifc entity attributes
question_paraphrase: Each time we want to use Ifc entity attributes as Name, LongName, Tag, Description we have to point to parameters with an Ifc prefix. We can't point Mark and Type Mark to Name. Double the amount of parameters.
phrasing_notes: implementation-manager voice, argues about user confusion
answer_summary: Autodesk: wants better UI including attributes, lower priority.

gloss_en: What do the I and T flags in the user-defined pset txt really mean when a pset can mix instance and type parameters?
title_original: User-defined Pset wit .txt file
question_paraphrase: I would like to ask what is the meaning of the I or T setting in the txt file. In a Property Set I can include values from both instance and type parameter, so I cannot understand what that statement refers to.
answer_summary: Create two psets, one T (IfcElementType) and one I; flag reflects where the pset is attached.

gloss_en: How to map two different parameters (duct width/height or diameter) to the same pset property depending on which exists, using the mapping table.
title_original: Mapping pset value from a parameter or another ? Mapping using built in parameter name ?
question_paraphrase: I did not find how to map 2 different parameters depending of which one is available in the object to the same pset property. Duct width and height for rectangular, diameter for round.
answer_summary: No answer in thread at time of reading.

gloss_en: Wants to map localized user-defined parameters into standard Common psets (e.g. Pset_WallCommon.FireRating) so users see parameters in their own language.
title_original: INQ: Mapping/Overwriting of user-defined parameters into IFC Common PSets
question_paraphrase: I found that if I make a user-parameter with the exact PSet-Property it is automatically mapped. I need my users to see the Revit parameters in our own language and not in English. Is there a way to override this mapping?

gloss_en: Office-wide ARC-Loadbearing type parameter cannot overwrite Pset_*Common.LoadBearing, which takes only the built-in instance value.
title_original: PR: Can't overwrite *_Common.LoadBearing with a user defined parameter
question_paraphrase: We implemented an office-wide ARC-Loadbearing parameter which we prefer as type parameter. With a supposedly correct mapping file the *Common.LoadBearing in the IFC takes only the built-in value.
answer_summary: Commenter: LoadBearing is an entity-level instance property so a type parameter is ignored.

gloss_en: Mapping Diameter/Width/Height to Pset_DuctSegmentTypeCommon and Pset_PipeSegmentCommon as in the Autodesk IFC Handbook does not export.
title_original: PR: Parameter Export Mapping
question_paraphrase: I'm trying to use the following export mapping to have the nominal dimensions of pipe and duct segments in the appropriate psets, as per the Autodesk IFC Handbook. Unfortunately this doesn't work.
phrasing_notes: pastes txt, 'Is it only me?' follow-up

gloss_en: Parameter mapping table txt is not applied for IFC2X3 export: Dutch fire-rating parameter does not reach Pset_WallCommon.FireRating.
title_original: PR: Export IFC - Export parameter mapping table not working for IFC2X3 schema
question_paraphrase: When exporting to IFC2X3 the mapping table txt does not map Revit parameters to Pset_*Common. Example: brandwerendheid is not mapped to Pset_WallCommon.FireRating.

gloss_en: Suspects a parameter in IFC Shared Parameters-RevitIFCBuiltIn.txt is wrongly typed versus the buildingSMART spec.
title_original: IFC Shared Parameter File
question_paraphrase: not sure about this, but is this Parameter wrong defined in IFC Shared Parameters-RevitIFCBuiltIn.txt? (compares with IfcSpace spec)
answer_summary: File is auto-generated from bSI; known issues.

gloss_en: Hidden shared parameters do not export via user-defined psets, IFC-prefixed schedules or calculated parameters.
title_original: hidden shared parameters are not exported to ifc
question_paraphrase: i tried to export a series of hidden shared parameters to IFC unfortunately they are ignored by the exporter. approaches: user defined property sets; schedule named IFC-Test; calculation parameter. result: no export for all 3 options.
phrasing_notes: lowercase, no punctuation, complains no reply in 3 weeks
answer_summary: Hidden (invisible) parameters are not available to the exporter.

gloss_en: PanelWidth in IFC Shared Parameters file typed as LENGTH instead of ratio so 930 mm exports as 1 and 0.5 exports as 0.00164.
title_original: IFC Shared Parameters-RevitIFCBuiltIn*.txt: wrong Parameter Type for PanelWidth
question_paraphrase: I was experimenting with an IfcDoor and wanted the optional PanelWidth correct. When I enter the actual PanelWidth (930mm) the Ifc property becomes 1. When I enter the ratio 0.5 it becomes 0.00164.
answer_summary: Type mismatch between shared parameter file and spec.

gloss_en: Why does the exporter iterate over all possible psets and fight for each value instead of iterating Revit parameters and mapping them?
title_original: ENH: Iterate on revit parameters instead of Psets
question_paraphrase: I know after so many years of development it may sound provocative, but why do we iterate through all possible properties in all psets and fight for each value instead of iterating through parameters of the element and use maps?
answer_summary: Autodesk: roadmap includes more control over which parameters export.

gloss_en: Schedule-based property sets ignore fields from Project Info, wants ScheduleFieldType.ProjectInfo supported.
title_original: Properties from Schedule, parameter on Project Info
question_paraphrase: When utilizing properties from Schedules, should the property set reflect the displayed schedule? Schedule fields from project info are ignored by this filter in the export code.

gloss_en: Built-in material parameters export only to hardcoded psets (Identity, Structural), cannot be routed into standard psets via the txt.
title_original: PR: not able to export built in material parameters into standardised IFC psets
question_paraphrase: Two ways material psets come out: from built-in parameters into hardcoded property sets called Identity or Structural, or using custom mapping from custom parameters.

gloss_en: Yes/No level parameter named AboveGround does not export as IfcLogical, but named Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon.AboveGround it does.
title_original: PR: Yes/No parameter named only AboveGround is not exported (IfcLogical)
question_paraphrase: I want to mark my building levels as above/below ground using Pset_BuildingStoreyCommon.AboveGround. Revit has no built-in checkbox so I create a project Yes/No parameter for Levels.
phrasing_notes: long, structured 'What I am trying to do' section

gloss_en: The shared parameter file created when linking an IFC is deleted immediately on first link, unlike on update.
title_original: INQ: Shared Parameter file is deleted once linking is done
question_paraphrase: As the title says, but it only happens when first linking an IFC file. When updating an IFC link a new shared parameter file is created and not deleted. Is this by design?

title_original: Parameter mapping
question_paraphrase: I have troubles with parameter mapping to FireRating. I have my own ParameterMappingTable.txt to set a Dutch named Firerating parameter in Pset_WallCommon. Revit also has its own Fire Rating which is not sufficient. I thought the mapping would override.

gloss_en: ParameterMappingTable maps fire-resistance parameter to Pset_MemberCommon FireRating only for some IfcMembers.
title_original: Parametermapping table not entirely working for IfcMembers
question_paraphrase: I noticed that for IfcMembers not every Revit parameter is correctly converted to Pset_MemberCommon via the ParameterMapping table. In Solibri only two objects show it.
answer_summary: Likely type vs instance source difference.

gloss_en: List all custom psets in the model and which entities carry them
prompt: list every pset in the model that isnt Pset_ or Qto_ , and which classes they sit on
expected_behavior: Enumerate property sets, filter out standard Pset_/Qto_ prefixes, group by IFC class with counts.

gloss_en: Fire rating is set on walls in Revit but missing in IFC
prompt: walls have FireRating in revit but Pset_WallCommon.FireRating is empty in the ifc?? which walls and where does the value live instead
expected_behavior: Check Pset_WallCommon.FireRating for IfcWall instances and types, find walls where it is missing, search other psets for fire rating-like properties, report likely mapping cause.

gloss_en: Which properties are on type vs instance for doors
prompt: for doors, show me which psets/props come from the type and which from the occurrence, flag dupes
expected_behavior: Compare psets on IfcDoorType vs IfcDoor, list properties present on each level, flag duplicated names/values.

expected_behavior: Create property set ARC_Data on each IfcWall with the two properties, derive CostGroup from Name prefix, leave other psets untouched, report counts.

expected_behavior: List all property sets on IfcDoor/IfcDoorType, compare with expected names, suggest checks: user-defined pset txt, I/T flag, parameter hidden or not shared, entity name.
